# Test fixtures

`sitemap.xsd` and `siteindex.xsd` are the official schemas of the Sitemaps protocol 0.9, copied unchanged from
<https://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9/>. The protocol and its schemas are published by sitemaps.org under the
[Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.5/) license. The tests
validate the generated files against them.
